description_en: Queries a list of built-in and custom extensions that are enabled in a workspace
description_zh: 调用ListEnabledExtensionsForProject来获取项目空间下已经开启的扩展程序列表，包含系统扩展程序和自定义扩展程序
name: ListEnabledExtensionsForProject

parameters.description_en: The code of the extension point event.
parameters.help_en: The code of the extension point event
parameters.name: event_code

parameters.description_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6b4d4941azHd2k) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID.

parameters.description_en:
The type of the code for the file.

Valid values: 6 (Shell), 10 (ODPS SQL), 11 (ODPS MR), 24 (ODPS Script), 99 (zero load), 221 (PyODPS 2), 225 (ODPS Spark), 227 (EMR Hive), 228 (EMR Spark), 229 (EMR Spark SQL), 230 (EMR MR), 239 (OSS object inspection), 257 (EMR Shell), 258 (EMR Spark Shell), 259 (EMR Presto), 260 (EMR Impala), 900 (real-time synchronization), 1089 (cross-tenant collaboration), 1091 (Hologres development), 1093 (Hologres SQL), 1100 (assignment), and 1221 (PyODPS 3).

You can call the [ListFileType](~~212428~~) operation to query the type of the code for the file.
parameters.description_zh:
文件的代码类型。

不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见[DataWorks节点合集](~~600169~~)。
您也可以调用[ListFileType](~~212428~~)接口，查询文件的代码类型。
